question: Simplify: 100⁰.²⁵ times 5² times 2⁴ times (1)/(800⁰.⁵⁾ times sqrt{(1)/(5)}
solution:
**Given:**

 100⁰.²⁵ times 5² times 2⁴ times (1)/(800⁰.⁵⁾ times sqrt{(1)/(5)} 

**Concept Used:**

 am times aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ 

 a⁻m = (1)/(am⁾ 

 sqrt{a} = a¹/² 

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow 100⁰.²⁵ = (10²)¹/⁴ = 10¹/² 

 Rightarrow 800⁰.⁵ = (16 times 50)¹/² = (16 times 5² times 2)¹/² 

 Rightarrow 800⁰.⁵ = (2⁴ times 5² times 2)¹/² = (2⁵ times 5²)¹/² 

 Rightarrow 800⁰.⁵ = 2⁵/² times 5 

 Rightarrow sqrt{(1)/(5)} = 5⁻¹/² 

 Rightarrow 10¹/² times 5² times 2⁴ times (1)/(2⁵/²⁾ times ⁵ times 5⁻¹/²

 Rightarrow 2¹/² ⁺ ⁴ ⁻ ⁵/² times 5¹/² ⁺ ² ⁻ ³/² 

 Rightarrow 2⁽¹/² ⁺ ⁴ ⁻ ⁵/²⁾ times 5⁽¹/² ⁺ ² ⁻ ³/²⁾
